t: Tilting wall-mount for flat-panel TVs. Features a fixed 6° tilt position and adaptor brackets to fit VESA patterns up to 200 x 200. Can be installed in 3 easy steps, attach brackets to TV, attach wall-plate to wall, hang TV on wall-plate. Locking system secures TV to wall for added safety.
b: Locking Mechanism Secures TV to Wall
